title: Bezier-Guided Adaptive Flow for Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30825v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-domain sequential recommendation aims to alleviate data sparsity and cold-start problems by transferring useful preference knowledge across domains. However, users exhibit varying degrees of preference consistency across domains, while existing methods often rely on global alignment objectives or coarse-grained transfer strategies. Such approaches may introduce irrelevant information and provide limited flexibility in adapting semantic representations to individual user preferences. To address these challenges, we propose BGAFlow, a personalized framework that combines state-adaptive semantic evolution with user-specific transfer control. BGAFlow first establishes a shared semantic space through unified dual-domain pretraining with user profiles inferred by a large language model (LLM). translated_title: 贝塞尔引导的自适应流用于跨域序列推荐
translated_abstract: 跨域序列推荐旨在通过跨领域迁移有用的偏好知识来缓解数据稀疏和冷启动问题。然而，用户在不同领域间表现出不同程度的偏好一致性，而现有方法通常依赖于全局对齐目标或粗粒度的迁移策略。这类方法可能会引入无关信息，并且在根据个人用户偏好调整语义表示方面灵活性有限。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了BGAFlow，这是一个将状态自适应语义演化与用户特定迁移控制相结合的个性化框架。BGAFlow首先通过统一的双域预训练建立共享语义空间，其中用户画像由大语言模型（LLM）推断得到。随后，基于潜在兴趣重叠度，它估计出一个个性化视界，以确定每个用户适当的迁移程度。为了实现……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出BGAFlow，一个结合贝塞尔引导的状态自适应语义演化与用户级迁移控制的个性化跨域序列推荐框架，利用LLM推断的用户画像和基于兴趣重叠度的个性化迁移视界，实现对跨域知识迁移的精确调控。
en_tdlr: BGAFlow is a personalized cross-domain sequential recommendation framework that combines Bezier-guided state-adaptive semantic evolution with user-specific transfer control, leveraging LLM-inferred user profiles and personalized transfer horizons to precisely adapt cross-domain knowledge transfer to individual users.
